name: Beam Cloud Pricing - Serverless per-second and On-demand per-machine GPU rates
notes: Fetched 2026-10-04. Three billing models. (1) Serverless GPU Tasks, billed by the millisecond only while code runs: RTX 4090 $0.000192/sec ($0.69/hr); H100 PCIe $0.000972/sec ($3.50/hr); RTX 5090 $0.000303/sec ($1.09/hr). CPU $0.0000125/sec/core standalone or $0.000105/sec/core attached to GPU; RAM $0.0000021/GiB standalone or $0.0000055/GiB attached. Example: RTX 4090 + 2 cores + 16 GiB = $1.77/hr. (2) On-demand machines, one flat price per machine including vCPU+RAM+NVMe: B200 $4.11/hr; H200 $2.09/hr; H100 PCIe $1.83/hr; A100 80GB $1.36/hr; RTX PRO 6000 $1.09/hr; L40S $0.76/hr; RTX 5090 $0.72/hr; A6000 $0.54/hr; RTX 4090 $0.44/hr. Example: 8h on H100 = $14.64 all-in. (3) BYOC management fee: $0.019/hr per vCPU + $0.009/hr per GB RAM, compute billed to your own cloud account. Storage $0.021/GB/month over 1TB. No egress or bandwidth fees on any plan. Clusters (multi-node InfiniBand) are contact-sales. Free tier: $0/month + usage, 5 GPU containers. Team: $89/month. Cost calculator on page shows H100 at $3.50/hr (serverless rate).
